Miner-influenceable block timestamp that drives the TWAP window length.

Division of cumulative price delta by timeElapsed in updateUsdtWeth(); same arithmetic risk.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is consumed by currentBlockTimestamp to build the TWAP timestamp.
The truncated timestamp flows into currentCumulativePrices as the blockTimestamp result.
update() consumes the timestamp-dependent cumulative prices returned by the library.
updateUsdtWeth() consumes the timestamp-dependent cumulative prices returned by the library.
Timestamp manipulation directly lengthens or shortens the divisor window of the TWAP division.
Timestamp manipulation directly affects the divisor window of the USDT TWAP division.
blockTimestampLast is subtracted from the current timestamp to produce the divisor of the division.
price0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the fresh cumulative value before division.
price1CumulativeLast is subtracted from the fresh cumulative value before division.
blockTimestampLastForUSDT forms the divisor of the USDT TWAP division.
price0CumulativeLastForUSDT is subtracted before the USDT division.
price1CumulativeLastForUSDT is subtracted before the USDT division.
timeElapsed is the divisor of the RAM/WETH cumulative price division.
timeElapsed is the divisor of the USDT/WETH cumulative price division.
Result of the division is stored as price0Average.
Result of the division is stored as price1Average.
Result of the division is stored as price0AverageForUSDT.
Result of the division is stored as price1AverageForUSDT.
pairRamWeth is the external contract invoked during the oracle update, exposing the update path to reentrant pair behaviour.
update() performs the external pair calls represented by this unsafe operation.
pairUsdtWeth is the external contract invoked during the oracle update, exposing the update path to reentrant pair behaviour.
updateUsdtWeth() performs the external pair calls represented by this unsafe operation.
update() stores the freshly read cumulative value back into price0CumulativeLast.
update() stores the freshly read cumulative value back into price1CumulativeLast.
update() refreshes the stored TWAP window timestamp.
updateUsdtWeth() stores the fresh cumulative value into price0CumulativeLastForUSDT.
updateUsdtWeth() stores the fresh cumulative value into price1CumulativeLastForUSDT.
updateUsdtWeth() refreshes the stored USDT TWAP window timestamp.
getData() calls update() first.
getData() calls updateUsdtWeth() after update().
getData() executes the final price division represented by this unsafe operation.
getData() reads token1 to validate the pair orientation.
getData() reads wethToken to decide the price composition branch.
getData() reads price1Average in the non-WETH-token0 branch.
getData() reads price0Average in the WETH-token0 branch.
getData() reads price0AverageForUSDT to derive the WETH/USDT price.
getData() reads price1AverageForUSDT to derive the WETH/USDT price.
The composed division result is stored into wethUSDTPrice.
The final composed price is written into tokenPrice.
consult() applies price0Average when the queried token is token0.
consult() applies price1Average when the queried token is token1.
consult() compares the argument against token0.
consult() validates the argument against token1.
The token parameter selects which stored average consult() uses.
The amountIn parameter is scaled by the selected TWAP average.
The local working price is assigned to tokenPrice.
